scope: Independent source review and synthetic CPU tests only; no registration, upload, model, PHY, GPU, source-data audit or bootstrap run.

resource_revision_proof.qualification: CPU source proof only; no promise of bitwise equivalence or that every real frame fits

independent_test.qualification: Synthetic CPU only; no model/PHY/GPU runtime

checks.name: Original owner unchanged
checks.detail: Old and revised owner bytes have identical SHA256. Original finite deadline, five stages, registered stage waits and shared timing coordination remain intact.

checks.name: Limited resource change
checks.detail: Actual assessor and own-allocator observer enforce 15 GiB admission, 14 GiB free plus verified current-process allocator credit, 12 GiB peak-reserved cap and 2 GiB free floor. Original host CPU/RAM/disk/utilization guards remain.

checks.name: Real model caps before construction
checks.detail: Visual IsolatedModels and score RealMetrics both call the 12 GiB PyTorch allocator limit before model construction. VAR/Dc and LPIPS/DINO numerical paths otherwise exactly match old sources; no extra qualification frames.

checks.name: Source read firewall and RX projection
checks.detail: Inverse source proof restores the original receiver, including SourceReadFirewall, actual-RX-only projection, model bundle, KEEP/DROP and failed-packet behavior. Metrics alone retain source pixels. Python audit enforcement is not an OS sandbox.

checks.name: Authenticated resource-v2 R0 closure only
checks.detail: Builder imports r0_finalize_resource_v2, validates adapter evidence and exact finalizer SHA, binds the v2 actual clean registration and both finalizer sources. It retains the original read-only receipt/ledger checks and does not repeat scientific computation.

checks.name: Frozen protocol and decision logic
checks.detail: Source and namespace, original 36000 physical/108000 packet/46800 logical limits, three noise seeds, N1024 and source dimensions, FP32/TF32off 6/2-thread settings, PSNR/LPIPS/DINO definitions, source averaging and DINO GO rule remain in the exact restored scientific sources.

checks.name: One dispatch and actual wait
checks.detail: Immutable dispatch launch and scientific-stage markers reject repeat entry; original authoritative output/run paths are retained. Own dispatch flock plus inherited owner/timing locks preserve coordination. Every launched owned child is waited, including receipt exceptions and deadline termination; failure is retained, no auto retry/successor.

checks.name: Timing v6 unchanged
checks.detail: Old timing registration pin and GPU0 eligibility rule unchanged. Quality thresholds are isolated from the registered timing entry.

limitations: Engineering approval does not establish real R1 numerical equivalence or successful runtime fit for every candidate. First actual calls must remain within the frozen ledger and fail closed without automatic retry.
This review does not perform registration, validate a newly generated R0 nomination on disk, or assert R1 completion.
The same authoritative r1_execution_v1 output path intentionally prevents a second independent scientific run; resource-v2 source identity must be recorded in registration.
